sn3.11:6.3: ‘Great king, as a layman enjoying sensual pleasures, living at home with your children, using sandalwood imported from Kāsi, wearing garlands, fragrance, and makeup, and accepting gold and currency, it’s hard for you to know
sn3.11:6.4: “who is perfected or on the path to perfection.”
sn3.11:6.5: You can get to know a person’s ethics by living with them. But only after a long time, not casually; only when attentive, not when inattentive; and only by the wise, not the witless.
sn3.11:6.6: You can get to know a person’s purity by dealing with them. But only after a long time, not casually; only when attentive, not when inattentive; and only by the wise, not the witless.
sn3.11:6.7: You can get to know a person’s resilience in times of trouble. But only after a long time, not casually; only when attentive, not when inattentive; and only by the wise, not the witless.
sn3.11:6.8: You can get to know a person’s wisdom by discussion. But only after a long time, not casually; only when attentive, not when inattentive; and only by the wise, not the witless.”
